For every cable, every motor winding, every electrical panel installed on-site, IR must be tested before commissioning + recorded. Governing standards: **IS 732:2019** (Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations), **IS 3043:2018** (Code of Practice for Earthing), **CEA Regulations 2010**. Without an IR Test Register, electrical compliance is unverifiable; statutory electrical inspector cannot approve installation. #### IR test methodology + acceptance **Equipment**: 500V or 1000V or 2500V DC megger (Megohmmeter); higher test voltage for higher rated cables. **Test conditions**: \- Apply test voltage between live conductor + earth \- Hold for minimum 60 seconds \- Record resistance value in megohms (MΩ) \- Test between phase-to-phase + phase-to-neutral + each phase-to-earth **Acceptance criteria** (per IS 732): \- **LV cables (≤ 1.1 kV)**: ≥ 1 MΩ per kV of voltage; minimum 1 MΩ \- **MV cables (3.3-33 kV)**: ≥ 100 MΩ-km (megohms × km of cable length) \- **HV cables (66 kV+)**: ≥ 1000 MΩ-km \- **Motor windings (newly installed)**: ≥ 100 MΩ \- **Switchboards / panel boards**: ≥ 100 MΩ each circuit **Test frequency**: \- **Pre-commissioning**: 100% of installation; mandatory \- **Annual maintenance**: rolling per equipment \- **Post-fault**: when fault occurred; verify integrity post-repair \- **Post-modification**: after any wiring change **Documentation**: equipment ID + location, test voltage, IR value, ambient temperature (affects readings), date, tester signature, equipment calibration ref. #### Common IR-test issues 1\. **Test voltage wrong** — using 500V megger on 11kV cable; reading meaningless. Match megger voltage to cable rating. 2\. **No temperature compensation** — IR varies with temperature (higher temp = lower resistance). Specify ambient + apply correction factor. 3\. **Test not held long enough** — short test (5-10s) reads transient + lower than actual; minimum 60s required. 4\. **Equipment energised during test** — dangerous + invalid results. Isolate + earth before testing. 5\. **No baseline / trend** — annual readings without baseline don't reveal gradual degradation. 6\. **Connection corrosion** — bad megger probe contact gives high reading (apparent good insulation); verify probe. 7\. **Damaged cable not retested after repair** — repair completed; IR test missed. 8\. **No statutory inspector certification** — large installations need Electrical Inspector approval; without IR Register, inspector won't certify. #### Cross-references **Companion formats**: \- [Earthing Test Register (FMT-MEP-009)](https://infralens.in/formats/mep/FMT-MEP-009_Earthing_Test_Register) — earthing resistance verification \- MEP cable schedule (BOQ + installation tracking) \- Statutory electrical inspector approval certificates **Codes + standards**: \- **IS 732:2019** — Code of practice for electrical wiring installations \- **IS 3043:2018** — Code of practice for earthing \- **IS 7098 (Parts 1-4)** — XLPE cables for various voltages \- **IS 1554 (Parts 1-2)** — PVC insulated cables \- **IS 13947 series** — Low voltage switchgear \- **CEA (Measures Relating to Safety + Electric Supply) Regulations 2010** \- **NEC 2023** — National Electrical Code India ### More related 📐IS / IRC codes - [IS 732](https://infralens.in/code/IS-732) ✏️Design rules - [Residential Connected Load Per Sqft](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/residential-connected-load-per-sqft) - [Commercial Connected Load Per Sqft](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/commercial-connected-load-per-sqft) ### Related Formats — MEP Testing & Commissioning - ✅ [AHU (Air Handling Unit) Commissioning Checklist\\ \\ checklist · FMT-MEP-001](https://infralens.in/formats/mep/ahu-air-handling-unit-commissioning-checklist) - ✅ [Chiller Commissioning Checklist\\ \\ checklist · FMT-MEP-002](https://infralens.in/formats/mep/chiller-commissioning-checklist) - 📊 [DG Set Load Test Protocol\\ \\ test-report · FMT-MEP-003](https://infralens.in/formats/mep/dg-set-load-test-protocol) - 📊 [Lift / Elevator Testing Protocol\\ \\ test-report · FMT-MEP-004](https://infralens.in/formats/mep/lift-elevator-testing-protocol) - 📊 [Fire Alarm System (FAS) T&C Protocol\\ \\ test-report · FMT-MEP-005](https://infralens.in/formats/mep/fire-alarm-system-fas-t-c-protocol) - 📊 [PA / Public Address System T&C\\ \\ test-report · FMT-MEP-006](https://infralens.in/formats/mep/pa-public-address-system-t-c)
